ios.desc:
Enjoy an intuitive swipe-based experience that makes finding your next favorite project fun and effortless.

DISCOVER REPOSITORIES YOUR WAY

• Swipe right to star repositories you love 
• Swipe left to pass on projects that aren't for you 
• Two discovery modes: Curated batches and Trending repos 
• Smart filtering by categories, programming languages, and star counts

CURATED MODE

Get personalized batches of hand-picked repositories based on your preferences. Apply filters to find exactly what you're looking for:

• Filter by categories (Web Development, Machine Learning, DevOps, Mobile, and more) 
• Set star count ranges to match your interests 
• Generate new batches daily (up to 10 per day) 
• Never see the same repository twice

TRENDING MODE

Stay on top of what's hot in the GitHub community:

• Browse trending repositories 
• Filter by programming language 
• Choose time periods: Daily, Weekly, or Monthly trends 
• Discover rising stars before they go viral 
• No batch limits - swipe as much as you want

RICH REPOSITORY DETAILS

Every repository card includes:

• Clear description and statistics 
• Language breakdown with color-coded visualization 
• README preview for quick insights 
• Topics, license information, and recent update date 
• Fork and star counts at a glance

GITHUB INTEGRATION

• Secure OAuth authentication 
• View repositories directly on GitHub 
• Your starred repos instantly sync to your GitHub profile

PRIVACY FOCUSED

Repomance is open source and respects your privacy. I only request the minimum GitHub permissions needed to star repositories on your behalf. No personal data is collected beyond what's necessary for GitHub API interaction.

OPEN SOURCE

Repomance is fully open source. Check out the code, contribute, or report issues on GitHub: github.com/mpospirit-apps/Repomance-iOS

SUPPORT

Visit repomance.com/support for help or feedback.

quotes.text:
Hi everyone,

Repomance is an app for discovering curated and trending repositories. Swipe to star them directly using your GitHub account.
It is currently available on iOS, iPadOS, and macOS. I plan to develop an Android version once the app reaches 100 users.

Repomance is open source: https://github.com/mpospirit-apps/Repomance-iOS

All feedback is welcome, hope you enjoy using it.
